QUOTE: The only caller of `retryFailedPost` is the failed-post bottom sheet's "Try Again" action (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:48`). Nothing retries on reconnect or on a timer.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry occurs only via the manual "Try Again" action on a failed post and names `retryFailedPost` as what it calls.
